Refunds aren't a broad trend — one merchant (OfficeHub Nordic) had a one-time spike (refund rate jumped from ~3% to 21% in Q3, €23k refunded) that's already back to normal; our big apparel sellers actually improved.

Our revenue number and Finance's don't match yet (€53k vs €94k for 2025 processing fees) — strong evidence points to a bug in one of the two calculations, and we're meeting to reconcile before either number goes to the board.

Before we can rank merchants by profitability, we found a data problem to fix first: one merchant's recorded shipping cost is 120% of its total sales — that's not realistic, so shipping-cost data needs a cleanup pass before it drives any business decisions.
